questions.prompt: Which ship carried Charles Darwin on his survey voyage?
questions.fact: He was invited largely as a dinner companion for the captain, whose rank forbade socialising with the crew.

questions.prompt: Which unit expresses the amount of substance in chemistry?
questions.fact: One contains about 6.02 times ten to the twenty-third particles, a number chosen so atomic mass in grams comes out neat.

questions.prompt: Which sport features a technique called the butterfly?
questions.fact: It developed out of breaststroke, when swimmers realised the rules did not forbid recovering the arms over the water.

questions.prompt: Which film features a toy cowboy named Woody?
questions.fact: An early version of the character was written as far nastier, and test audiences disliked him so much he was rewritten.

questions.prompt: Which mountain range separates Asia from the Indian subcontinent?
questions.fact: It is still rising by around five millimetres a year as the Indian plate pushes north.

questions.prompt: Which Dickens novel opens in a debtors' prison?
questions.fact: His own father was imprisoned for debt when he was twelve, and he was sent to work in a factory.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym MFA describe?
questions.fact: A hardware key is the strongest common form, because it verifies the site as well as the user.
